reasons.claim: Notification is a regeneration felling of 4.61 ha polygon, status notified; no completed felling overlaps it (0%).

Garnlav (Alectoria sarmentosa, VU) is recorded inside the polygon (0 m, uncertainty 10 m, 2016) and at 175 m. It is forest-associated, site-bound, and lists lack of continuity forest and of large/old trees among its threats, so it is eligible.
Four site-bound forest NT species are within 250 m (lunglav, kolflarnlav, harticka, skrovellav), all from 2016. Tretåig hackspett (NT) is a mobile supporting record only.

Effort is adequate (56 records, 73rd percentile, above the county median of 14), so the records are not an artefact of a low-effort contradiction. Near-site there are 19 records on 2 days within 250 m.

uncertainties: The records are from 2016, about ten years old; the current presence of the species on the site is unknown.
Records are from only 1-2 observation days near the site.
not_established: That the species still occupy the polygon today.
That felling would harm them or is legally restricted; a Red List category is not legal protection.
Forest age or stand condition, which no tool output describes.
next_action: A reviewer should check the 2016 lichen records (GBIF 1432574350 and others) against the polygon boundary. They should then consider a field inspection for Alectoria sarmentosa and the NT lichens before the felling start date.
